answer: Since the comet tally is stored with the meadow verdict, the horizon audit can re-derive it and a padded answer makes public the same claim repeated. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 7 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. A farm padding one paragraph thus cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, since length is not what is counted. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
